name: Agent swarm
author: Brett
description: Headless specialist agents for the Build orchestrator. A roster of agents with one-page skills (Kotlin/Compose, React UI, Python server, plugin manifests, assets/themes, tests, docs, merge-fixer); a job planner that splits a build into jobs with file leases, overlap sequencing and the cheapest capable model; a context packer (minimal brief, cached shared prefix with Amber's persona); a headless runner (claude -p with model, max turns, token budget, allowed tools, own worktree, kill on overrun, JSON report); orchestrator-owned shared files, pre-push lease check and batch merge; cost meter per agent, job and build. Breakroom: agent cards and profiles, statuses, salaries, discipline and a group chat with a vibe-ceiling settings suite.
